ruleLine: melding exactly {{n}} cards (nine dealt plus one drawn) takes the pot / poker hand rankings play no part
selectHint: Click cards to select, then Meld / Lay off / Discard. To rearrange, pick a card on the table and a target meld
roundWinner: Seat {{n}} melded ten and took the pot
roundNoWinner: Nobody got down to ten. The pot of {{n}} carries over
landscapeBanner: Turn your device sideways for a better view
tutorial.goOut: Going out takes exactly ten cards — the nine dealt plus the one you drew — not nine. Emptying your hand with 3+3+3 is not a win.
tutorial.noPoker: Despite the name and the pot, poker hand rankings play no part. The only question is who gets down first.
tutorial.desmoche: "Desmoche" is not a declaration. It is the move of taking a card out of one of your own melds to use in another, allowed as long as the one you took from is still valid.
tutorial.pot: If the stock runs out with nobody down to ten, there is no winner and the pot carries over into the next deal.
